title: Foundation Model Training Pipeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Prompt Engineering
description: A three-stage walkthrough of how raw text becomes a useful AI assistant - pre-training, fine-tuning, and inference - with a toggle that swaps plain-language explanations for concrete sample data.

learningObjectives: Explain how pre-training, fine-tuning, and transfer learning work together to create a useful language model

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Step-through pipeline with progressive disclosure of concrete example data
keyQuestions: Which stage can a prompt engineer actually influence?
Where does a model's willingness to refuse harmful requests come from?
commonMisconceptions: Believing the model learns from your prompts during a conversation
assessmentOpportunities: Name the three stages in order and what each produces
Explain the difference between pre-training and fine-tuning in one sentence
